name: Buyway ~Nigemichi~
source:
The seventeen-year-old girl, who loved cameras, went into the woods to take some photos, and ended up lost in front of a Western-style mansion she’d never seen before.
Strangely, no matter where she walked, she couldn’t get out of the place or find her way back to the forest.
Inside were four shady-looking young guys.
She had no clue if they were friends or enemies, it totally threw her off.
But all she could do was try desperately to escape...
All she could do was pick one guy—believe in him—and hope for the best... 

[Translated from [url=https://bangumi.tv/subject/226508]bangumi[/url]]
translation:
一个喜欢相机的17岁女孩，进森林拍照时迷了路，来到了一栋从未见过的西式宅邸前。
奇怪的是，无论往哪里走，她都无法离开这里，也找不到回到森林的路。
宅邸里住着四个看起来可疑的年轻男人。
她完全不知道他们是敌是友，不知所措。
可她能做的，只有拼命寻找逃离的方法……
只能选择其中一人，相信他，再祈求一切顺利……

[译自[url=https://bangumi.tv/subject/226508]Bangumi[/url]]
